item.tib: bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs sgrub snang srid dbang sgyur
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar gsang ba sngags kyi cha lag las kyi mtha' bsdu gsang ba'i man ngag sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i phyag cha/ bstan dgra rtsad nas gcod pa'i mde'u/ 'chi med gsang 'dus gshen gyi lung don/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyi mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha nyid kyi smar byang / bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs sgrub snang srid dbang bsgyur ngo mtshar lam gyi rim pa 'di yang / drin can bla ma'i bka' gsung phab pa dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis yang yang bskul ba dang*/ ma zad rigs mthun gyi grogs po drang srong dbang 'dus dang stag rgod btsun pa bstan 'dzin phun tshogs zung gis dar dkar lha rdzas dang rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo/ rten 'brel legs mtshon gyis sna drangs te bskul ba la brten nas/ mkhas pa dmu tsha gyer med kyi bka' yi pho nya/ sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'jug nges med kho bo bdag ni dbyings kyi yum chen bya ra ma gsum gyi grogs bgyis nas/ rtse drug lhun sgang spyi spungs sgrub pa'i gnas su phyin nas/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyis bdag la brgyud cing gdams nas/ slar yang lo dus kyi gsang rgya yol nas/ snyigs dus kyi skabs su bab pa'i kho bo sdom brtson tha shal ba rgod rje rgya yi rus thob tshe dbang bde chen snying po 'am/ gsang ba'i ming ni g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa'i rgyal khams kyi khol po ba zog po te (gte) rgan des/ dbal gyi phur pa nag pos byin gyis rlabs (brlabs pa'i)gnas kyi mdun zhol/ g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa'i me ro spar ba'i rlung g.yab/ dpal ldan nor bu gling gi ri khrod kun bzang bde chen pho brang du dus dang skabs su bab nas/ stang chen dmu tsha'i zhal lung bzhin du dkar chag yi ger bstab (btab) pa'o//
